title: Thick closure of an object
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] and $K$ an object. The thick closure $\langle K\rangle$ is the smallest full subcategory containing $K$ and closed under isomorphisms, all integer shifts, distinguished cones, and direct summands. Equivalently, an object $Q$ belongs to it if every full triangulated subcategory stable under direct summands and containing $K$ also contains $Q$.
